stratagems.name: Inquisitorial Mandate
stratagems.target: One INQUISITOR model from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one friendly IMPERIUM unit within 12" of that INQUISITOR. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a model in the selected unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

stratagems.name: Scribe of Fate
stratagems.target: One AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack against an enemy CHARACTER, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Rogue Trader Allies
stratagems.when: Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit from your army that is in Reserves.
stratagems.effect: Set up that unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy models.
